title: This Animal Can Regrow Its Legs, Heart Parts and Spinal Cord

scenes.text: This animal can regrow its own legs. Over and over.
It's the axolotl, a salamander from Mexico.
Lose a leg and it grows back. Again and again.
It can also repair parts of its heart and spinal cord, even sections of its brain.
And it heals with no scarring at all.
Scientists are studying it hoping humans might learn the trick.

description:
Axolotls can regrow whole limbs repeatedly, and repair parts of their heart, spinal cord and brain without scarring.
Scientists at places like the Marine Biological Laboratory are studying how, hoping to unlock the same abilities in people.
What body part would you regrow? Comment below.
first_comment: If you could regrow any body part, which would you pick, and why?
